summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing that its board granted 28,030 employee warrants on November 10, 2026 under Appendix 1a of its Articles of Association, with each warrant exercisable for one ordinary share at US$256.59, the grant-date closing price. Vesting is 25% on the first anniversary and the remaining 75% monthly over 36 months thereafter, subject to continued service and accelerated vesting on certain exit events. The filing also amends the Articles and notes 1,431,143 shares remain available for future grant. This is an ordinary equity-compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
